The trusted system of record for your company's AI spend.

posts.name: witr
posts.tagline: Why is this running? Trace process, port, container or file

Run it bare for an interactive TUI with Processes, Ports, Containers and Locks tabs. Or script it: --short for a one-line chain, --json with real exit codes. One static Go binary for Linux, macOS, Windows and BSD.
